failedToAnalyzeDescMakeAccessible: Make sure the drive is accessible
failedToAnalyzeErrorWindows: Failed to analyze drive {{drive}}:. Make sure the drive is accessible.
failedToAnalyzeErrorOther: Failed to analyze drive {{drive}}. Make sure the drive is accessible.
failedToScanFileTypesWindows: Failed to scan file types on {{drive}}:.
failedToScanFileTypesOther: Failed to scan file types on {{drive}}.
fileTypesEmptyDescription: Click Analyze first, then switch to File Types view to scan.
repairDescription: Use these built-in Windows tools to scan for and repair corrupted system files.
repairRunOrder: Run {{dism}} first to repair the component store, then {{sfc}} to fix system files.
dismCardDescription: Scans the Windows component store for corruption and repairs it using Windows Update. Run this before SFC if system files can't be repaired.
sfcCardDescription: Scans all protected Windows system files and replaces corrupted or missing files with a cached copy from the component store.
restartRecommended: A restart is recommended to complete repairs
adminRequiredSfcDesc: Relaunch Kudu as administrator to run SFC.
adminRequiredDismDesc: Relaunch Kudu as administrator to run DISM.
chkdskCardSubtitle: Check disk for file system errors
chkdskCardDescription: Scans the file system and metadata for errors. This is a non-destructive read-only scan that reports problems without making changes.
adminRequiredChkdskDesc: Relaunch Kudu as administrator to run CHKDSK.
maintenanceDescription: Run TRIM on SSDs to keep write performance and lifespan healthy.
trimInfoBody: TRIM tells your SSD which blocks are no longer in use so it can erase them ahead of time. The OS already does this on a schedule — running it manually only helps when that schedule has lagged. HDDs do not need TRIM.
trimEmptyNoDrives: Couldn't enumerate any drives on this system.
trimEmptyFiltered: No drives match the current filter.
trimConfirmDescription_one: TRIM will run on {{count}} selected drive. This requires administrator privileges and may briefly slow disk I/O.
trimConfirmDescription_other: TRIM will run on {{count}} selected drives. This requires administrator privileges and may briefly slow disk I/O.
adminRequiredTrimDesc: Relaunch Kudu as administrator to run TRIM.
trimThrottledToast_one: {{count}} drive was trimmed less than 24 hours ago — skipped
trimThrottledToast_other: {{count}} drives were trimmed less than 24 hours ago — skipped

storage.title: Storage History
storage.description: Track local folder growth and compare storage snapshots
storage.privacy: Snapshots contain folder names and size metadata only, stored locally for up to 90 days within a 250 MB budget. Global exclusions apply. Logical sizes count each file path; links, other mounted volumes and Kudu's own data are excluded. No file contents are read or uploaded.
storage.capturing: Capturing metadata since {{time}}. You can leave this page.
storage.projectionValue: Around {{days}} days remaining at {{growth}} of growth per day.
storage.projectionRange: Approximate model range: {{min}}?{{max}} days, based on {{count}} daily observations.
storage.noProjection: A forecast needs at least seven comparable daily observations spanning seven days and a stable positive growth trend.
storage.projectionCaution: This estimates the whole volume from free-space measurements. Other applications and folders affect it. The range describes model fit, not a guarantee or proof of what caused growth.
storage.empty: Capture a baseline to begin. Incomplete or unavailable scans are kept with their status.
storage.compareHint: Choose an earlier Before and a later After snapshot. Only complete snapshots with the same volume, folder and exclusions can be compared.
storage.overlap: Rows include parent and child folders; do not add their totals together. Added/removed paths may represent moves or renames. Folder detail is retained for three levels; sizes include deeper files.
storage.noChanges: No folder changes in this comparison.
storage.deleteScopeConfirm: Stop automatic snapshots and delete this folder's local snapshot history? The actual folder and files will not be changed.
storage.deleteConfirm: Delete this local snapshot? Comparisons using it will no longer be available. Actual files are not affected.
storage.daily: Capture daily while Kudu is running
storage.dailyHint: Checks every ten minutes. Waits for AC power, two minutes of idle time and Game Mode to finish. At most one daily attempt per folder; offline attempts are recorded. Alerts are limited to once per folder per day and respect completion notifications.
storage.growthAlert: Growth alert (GiB since previous snapshot; blank disables)

reason.limit: Stopped at the scan limit; deeper folders may be missing
reason.changed: The folder or volume changed during the scan
reason.inaccessible: Some folders could not be read
reason.excluded: The folder is covered by a global exclusion
reason.cancelled: The capture was cancelled before it finished
reason.unavailable: The folder became unavailable during the scan

comparisonReason.incomplete: Partial, cancelled or unavailable snapshots cannot support a reliable growth comparison.
comparisonReason.scope: The volume, folder, exclusions or measurement policy differ.
comparisonReason.order: Choose an After snapshot taken later than Before.
